method.order: four left-to-right native row assemblies, then top-to-bottom row assembly, then crop 115px perimeter
method.cost: mean squared unmodified RGB difference at identical overlapping coordinates
method.tieBreak: argmin first match; predecessor -1,0,+1; smallest terminal coordinate on ties
method.sourceSelection: earlier source before seam; later source on/after seam

provenance.format: compressed numpy arrays, not game art
provenance.valueMeaning: uint8 sourceId 0..15 as listed in sources; every position records the selected source
provenance.nativeCoordinateRule: For tile pixel (x,y) owned by sourceId: source x=x+115-(sourceId%4)*1024; source y=y+115-(sourceId//4)*1024. For padded pixels omit +115.
